ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The following figure is a "schematic diagram of the planning of functional zones in a certain city." Read the figure and answer: As ecological city planning, what functional zone should functional zone 2 in the figure be planned as? <image1>
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The legend on the right side of the figure shows that the number "2" corresponds to the functional zone filled with horizontal stripes. In the figure, this kind of horizontal-striped area is mainly distributed on the edge of the urban construction area or near major traffic arteries, and there is a certain separation between it and other residential land. Then reason: In ecological city planning, industrial zones usually occupy relatively large areas, have a strong dependence on transportation, and at the same time need to maintain an appropriate distance from residential areas, so as to reduce pollution and disturbance. Therefore, functional zone 2 in the figure should be planned as an industrial zone.
